messages:
morgan: Cutting RC from main: keystone v2.14.0-rc1. Tagging artifacts now (registry/redwood/keystone:2.14.0-rc1). Can someone ack QA and pin config?

julia: Ack QA smoke on staging — basic flows, embeddings, and auth flows looked green. No DB migrations in this RC. :thumbsup:

sam: quick regression pass done, saw an odd timing spike on tokenization microbench but probably noise. Pushed a tiny test fix earlier; not included in this RC.

nick: Requesting config pin for feature flag: `FEATURE_FLAGS=keystone_v2` — I’ll pin on the deploy config once we decide promo window.

morgan: Promo window: 14:30–15:30 UTC today. Plan: canary 5% -> monitor 10m -> 25% -> monitor 20m -> full. Any objections?

lisa: Sheriff available for the window. I can watch telemetry and take rollback if SLOs breach.

sheriff: I’ll be online. Add me to the pager if error-rate > 0.5% or latency p95 > 800ms.

deploy-bot: rc-create: registry/redwood/keystone:2.14.0-rc1 recorded. CI: 187/187 passed. Artifacts checksum: sha256:abcd1234. Canary job scheduled at 1712350800.

julia: small last-minute note: there’s a flaky unit test on pipeline that I couldn't repro locally — not in release path, but flagging.

morgan: OK, given QA + CI green and sheriff, requesting pin + promo decision. @nick please pin and start canary when ready.

nick: Pin done: deploy-config `keystone_rc: 2.14.0-rc1` (config-server key updated). Starting canary now.

deploy-bot: canary-start: deployment/keystone -> replica set rs-keystone-rc1 created. traffic-split: 5% -> canary. Monitor hooks: telemetry, errors, kv-cache-warm.

sam: Observing initial canary logs — a handful of 502s in the first 30s, looks like a transient LB connection issue. Retrying.

lisa: Telemetry: error-rate spike to 0.9% at t+1m, then down to 0.2% after retries. No user-facing alerts.

morgan: Hold for 10m to watch trend. If errors drop <0.5% and p95 stable, proceed to 25%.

(8 minutes pass)

julia: post-8m check: error-rate steady ~0.15%, p95 ~720ms. KV warm appears ok. Recommend continue.

morgan: Proceeding to 25% now. Nick, please ramp.

nick: Ramping to 25%.

deploy-bot: traffic-update: 25% canary. Canary monitors running. Next check in 20m.

(14 minutes pass)

sam: Heads-up — found a low-severity data edge where the new tokenizer returns a slightly different token order for emojis; affects a small reranking path. No crash, just ordering difference.

julia: QA confirms no functional regressions for product flows, but reranking numeric score diffs present in ~0.2% of requests.

morgan: Given low impact and only rerank ordering, I propose continuing promo but add a post-promo eval alert and a quick rollback playbook ready. Any strong objections?

lisa: I’m fine with proceeding. Have rollback command ready.

sheriff: Agree. If alert hits >=0.5% in 30m, we rollback.

(sam posts rollback snippet)

sam: Rollback steps (if needed):

```
# revert to previous stable
kubectl set image deployment/keystone registry/redwood/keystone:2.13.4 --namespace=prod
kubectl rollout status deployment/keystone --namespace=prod
# Or use the release controller
releasectl promote --target stable --artifact registry/redwood/keystone:2.13.4
```

morgan: OK final check: CI + QA + sheriff + pin confirmed. Promoting to prod now — full rollout over 40m with progressive traffic. Nick kick it.

nick: Starting full rollout. Will post updates.

deploy-bot: promo-start: rolling update initiated for deployment/keystone -> target: registry/redwood/keystone:2.14.0-rc1. Expected full traffic at 1712351562. Healthchecks: enabled.

(5m)

lisa: Early metrics: p95 +40ms, errors steady at 0.18%. No alerts.

julia: Post-promo smoke: embeddings and chat look good. Logging shows new token-order differences in rerank logs at ~0.2% rate as expected.

morgan: Marking release notes: include note about tokenizer ordering change and guidance for rerank sensitivity. Assign to docs for a quick blurb.

(18m)

sam: minor regression: a downstream consumer expects deterministic token order; opened a PR to make the consumer resilient. Not rolling back.

(32m)

lisa: All clear. Traffic at 100%, no meaningful regressions.

morgan: Promo complete. Closing RC thread. Thanks everyone. :tada:

deploy-bot: promo-complete: deployment/keystone at 100% with artifact registry/redwood/keystone:2.14.0-rc1. Duration: 36m.
